description: Header file defining the 'closed_rx_window_handler' class and related structures for managing closed reception windows in an OFH (Open Fronthaul) context, including configuration, dependencies, and methods for handling symbols, metrics, and context.

classes.name: closed_rx_window_handler
classes.description: Manages the closed reception window for OFH, handling symbol processing, context management, and metrics collection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the handler by resetting the stop manager.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the handler via the stop manager.

methods.name: on_new_symbol
methods.description: Handles a new symbol event in the reception window.

methods.name: start_logging_unreceived_messages
methods.description: Enables logging of unreceived OFH messages if configured.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects metrics related to the reception window.

methods.name: handle_uplink_context
methods.description: Processes uplink context for a given symbol point.

methods.name: handle_prach_context
methods.description: Processes PRACH context for a given symbol point.
